proposition: EvidenceState::is_actionable returns true exactly for EvidenceState::Actionable.
non_claims: Does not establish correct upstream evidence admission.
This design example is not a registered assurance claim or proof receipt.
Constructor coverage does not establish whole-program correctness or specification adequacy.
domain: Every EvidenceState constructor, selected by a symbolic usize index into the exhaustive, duplicate-checked EVIDENCE_STATES domain.
assumptions: The symbolic usize index is constrained below EVIDENCE_STATES.len(); the generated exhaustive match rejects omitted, duplicated, or newly added production constructors.
trust_dependencies: Compiler enforcement of exhaustive, nonduplicate constructor-domain declarations
Source closure must be expanded to actual consumed inputs before native applicability is established.

bounds.unwind_policy: No explicit unwind attribute on this harness; retain effective native configuration.

negative_controls: Mutation control: make a non-Actionable variant return true and require the harness to fail.
Compiler control: omit or duplicate a constructor, or add a production enum variant without extending the proof domain; the generated guard must reject compilation.
Guard-removal control: removing the exhaustive guard permits an omitted constructor while ordinary behavior tests remain green; those tests alone do not establish domain completeness.
Range control: constrain the symbolic index below EVIDENCE_STATES.len() - 1; an unsatisfied constructor cover must reject result admission even when native assertions and process exit succeed.
result_satisfaction: Every selected subject has one exact current native result and every required cover is reachable.
